 Jitendra Rathore

 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:

High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Vinod Mishra - Panel Lawyer for the State.

Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.119/2024 dated 03/03/2024 registered at Police Station Kotwali Anuppur, District Anuppur for the offence punishable under Section 342, 376, 376(2)n,
294, 323, 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

2 . It is contended by the counsel that in connection with incident of September, 2023, FIR has been lodged on 13/03/2024 and this inordinate delay of six month has not been explained by the prosecution.

The prosecutrix has clearly stated in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. that she was in affair with the present applicant and she did not want to lodge any report against the applicant.
It is contended by the counsel that later on parents of the prosecutrix persuaded her to lodge the report against the present applicant.
The applicant is in custody since 03/03/2024 and trial would take considerable time to conclude, therefore, the applicant be 2 MCRC-33651-2024 released on bail.
4. The counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that DNA report is positive and the prosecutrix is minor, therefore, the applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
5. Heard the submissions and perusal of statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. which suggests relationship between the prosecutrix and the applicant.
The applicant is aged about 23 years and is in custody since 03/03/2024.

6. Looking to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court finds it to be a fit case Jitendra Rathore vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/87211703/
1 to release the applicant on bail.

entities.text: Jitendra Rathore vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant Jitendra Rathore shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.

8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Cr.P.C.
(MANINDER S. BHATTI) JUDGE Astha Jitendra Rathore vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/87211703/
